summary: Close the operator-facing UI product-experience gap while preserving ADR-0047 host-owned identity, generated-SDK, server-authoritative tenancy/approval and non-persistent browser-state boundaries.

impacts.evidence: The richer dashboard, command search and entity drawers use only existing capability-authorized public APIs; no organization/workspace browser selector or cross-tenant search path is introduced.
Theme/density stay in process memory and table views use display-only URL state; no localStorage, sessionStorage or cookie persistence is introduced for tokens, credentials or tenant business data.
Task 119 adds no HTTP operation and consumes the existing generated TypeScript SDK including already-published warehouse incident and fulfillment allocation reads.
No event envelope, event payload version, topic or producer semantics change.
Connector SDK/provider contracts remain unchanged; handwritten frontend code consumes the generated non-secret connector catalog rather than importing provider implementations.
Task 119 introduces no persistence schema; the migration catalog remains at 000074.

Host-owned OIDC, in-memory bearer handling, capability route guards, same-origin SDK transport and the static no-browser-persistence/no-provider-branching checks remain intact; global search is capability gated.
Sensitive approval execution receives an extra confirmation dialog, but server approval state and idempotent execution remain authoritative and the dialog is not treated as authorization.
The UI now exposes existing warehouse incident, fulfillment replacement and reconciliation evidence more clearly; it does not create a browser-side audit store or alter immutable backend lineage.
Drift comparison and operator controls are presentation changes over existing idempotent resolve/run APIs; no reconciliation state transition or write semantics change.
Task 119 adds no webhook sender or browser egress path beyond the existing same-origin API client.
Operational dashboard and activity center expose current bounded API state, while loading skeletons/error/toast feedback improve operator visibility without changing backend SLO claims.
Task 119 is a static frontend change with no data migration; rollback remains deployment of the prior API-compatible frontend bundle.

The frontend gate expands from 12 to 18 deterministic tests covering operator dashboard, DataTable, incident/fulfillment surfaces, integration drawers, responsive labels, dark mode, focus and reduced motion while retaining the original security policy checks.
